methods.label: Remaining seconds
methods.explanation: 1 minute is 60 seconds. After 15 seconds have passed, 45 seconds remain.
methods.levelReason: Uses the Grade 3 minute-second relationship and elementary part-total subtraction.

candidate.annotationRationale:
The displayed question asks only for a numerical difference. The retained time example uses part-total subtraction, cnm_p035, supported locally by the minute-second relationship, cnm_p061. It does not demonstrate the column algorithm specified by cnm_p034; a route-neutral subtraction target is proposed below.

needsNewNodes.name: Exact subtraction within 100 without a prescribed method
needsNewNodes.description: Compute \(a-b\) for whole numbers satisfying \(0\le b\le a\le100\), using any valid elementary method.
needsNewNodes.reason: The task requires the difference 60-15. cnm_p032 restricts subtraction to a one-digit number or a multiple of ten, while cnm_p034 specifically requires column subtraction. Neither supplies the route-neutral target.

limitations: A numeric response alone does not establish a particular written method. Preserve the recorded flag: numeric_response_does_not_verify_specific_written_or_conjugate_method.
candidate.changeReason: The time example correctly represents 60-15, and 45+15=60 confirms the result. The current explanation is sufficient and remains unchanged.
